lines.cap: There was once a company with twice as many soldiers as the British Army. And it answered to its shareholders.
lines.say: There was once a company with twice as many soldiers as the British Army. And it answered to its shareholders.

lines.cap: The East India Company. It started in 1600 with a royal charter, to trade spices and silk.
lines.say: The East India Company. It started in 1600 with a royal charter, to trade spices and silk.

lines.cap: Trade needed protection. So it hired soldiers. By 1803, around two hundred and sixty thousand. Twice the British Army.
lines.say: Trade needed protection. So it hired soldiers. By 1803, around two hundred and sixty thousand. Twice the British Army.

lines.cap: In 1757, its army defeated the ruler of Bengal. Partly by bribing his commander to stand aside.
lines.say: In 1757, its army defeated the ruler of Bengal. Partly by bribing his commander to stand aside.

lines.cap: Soon a business, run from an office in London, was ruling millions of people in India. Collecting their taxes.
lines.say: Soon a business, run from an office in London, was ruling millions of people in India. Collecting their taxes.

lines.cap: In 1770, a terrible famine hit Bengal. Millions died. The company kept collecting taxes.
lines.say: In 1770, a terrible famine hit Bengal. Millions died. The company kept collecting taxes.

lines.cap: After a huge uprising in 1857, the British government took over. The company was shut down in 1874.
lines.say: After a huge uprising in 1857, the British government took over. The company was shut down in 1874.

lines.cap: Imagine your company's annual report. Revenue: up. Countries conquered: also up.
lines.say: Imagine your company's annual report. Revenue: up. Countries conquered: also up.
